hints.title: Digit Sum by Base-2 Addition
hints.text: Represent each power assignment in binary and propagate carries sequentially across bit positions.

hints.title: Carry Propagation State
hints.text: At bit index i, assign t occurrences of 2 to the power of i, adding t to the incoming carry.

hints.title: Combinatorial Weighting
hints.text: Multiply subproblem solutions by combinations of choosing t items out of the remaining quota and nums[i] raised to t.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Carry is strictly bounded by m.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Enumerating all sequences of length m from n elements grows as n^m.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Precomputing Pascal triangle values avoids repeated factorial calculations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Model the addition process bit-by-bit with carry handling and combinatorial distribution.
